current_prompt.body:
READ the provided privacy policy excerpt
FOR EACH statement IN the excerpt
MAP the statement TO the specific GDPR article(s) it relates to
IDENTIFY any GDPR requirements THAT ARE NOT COVERED BY the policy
RETURN a mapping of statements to GDPR articles and a list of uncovered GDPR requirements
